notes.title: New Language Options Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello, hidden object adventure fans! We’re happy to announce that Dream Catcher Chronicles: Manitou is now available to play in multiple languages. The game has been updated to include German, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch and Brazilian Portuguese translations. No matter your native tongue, you can now enjoy this romantic hidden object game in your own language! To celebrate, you can grab it now for 65% off!

So what are you waiting for? Help Singing Star find her missing husband White Wolf today!
